limitations: AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer enqueue is counted as enqueued for presentation, not as presented.
Only the experimental Metal path reports an observed presentation, and it changes timing itself.
No metric measures capture-to-photon; that needs external measurement.
Frame header cap is stamped at encoder submission, not at capture.
Cross-device spans use a ping/pong clock offset; error is up to about half the best round trip.
Byte counts are app payload, not bytes billed by a network.
Trials cover whole 5 s diagnostics windows after the warm-up; up to one window at each end is outside the measurement.

Receiver numbers are the receiver's own 5 s windows, each counted once, that began after the trial's first sender window began; they are not aligned with the sender's windows and the last one may end up to one window after the trial.
Frame-ID counts exist only on the receiver's experimental Metal path, which itself changes presentation timing.
Operator steps are done by hand; their timing varies between trials.

metrics.caveat: ScreenCaptureKit delivers a complete frame only when the screen changed, so long intervals on a static screen are idle, not stalls. Capture runs at about 2x the target rate (DisplayCaptureSettings).
metrics.source: MacSender stream(_:didOutputSampleBuffer:) frames with SCFrameStatus.complete (display capture)

metrics.caveat: Includes the rate limiter's trailing-edge hold and any replay delay. Display capture only: Window view composites have no capture PTS, so nothing is recorded there.
metrics.source: MacSender.encode: host clock now minus the ScreenCaptureKit sample PTS of the pixels being submitted

metrics.caveat: Includes VideoToolbox's own queueing when more than one frame is in flight (StreamingPriority in-flight limit 1/2/3).
metrics.source: VTCompressionSession submit (MacSender.encode) to its output callback

metrics.caveat: Counts duplicates and replays too; see the submit counters for source-unique frames.
metrics.source: Successive encoder submissions in MacSender.encode

metrics.caveat: A TCP/QUIC send completion means the local stack accepted the bytes, not that the receiver got them.
metrics.source: MacSender.sendFramed: frame handed to the transport until its send completion

metrics.caveat: CPU-side time to build and render the composite; GPU work that finishes later is not included.
metrics.source: WindowWorkspaceEngine.composeTick around WorkspaceCompositor.compose

metrics.caveat: The engine composes only when a pane changed, plus about one resend per second when static.
metrics.source: Successive composites in WindowWorkspaceEngine.composeTick

metrics.caveat: One sample per restart (reconnect, retune, mode change). The interval stages restart their baselines at a restart, so this gap is not in them.
metrics.source: Last encoder submission of the previous capture generation to the first submission of the new one (StreamDiagnosticsRecorder.noteGeneration)

metrics.caveat: A long gap can be an idle source; compare with the sender's capture and submit rates.
metrics.source: StreamReceiver.presentDecodedSample: successive complete video frames off the wire

metrics.caveat: The performance overlay labels this "encode". cap is stamped at encoder submission, not at capture, so this is encode plus packaging, not capture-to-send.
metrics.source: Frame header snd minus cap (both written by the sender)

metrics.caveat: The performance overlay labels this "latency". It starts at encoder submission (not capture) and ends when the frame is handed to the presenter, before any A/V delay, queueing, decode or display. Offset error is up to about half the best round trip. Values outside -50 to 5000 ms are dropped (clock mapping not settled), so p99 and max under-report a pathological latency.
metrics.source: Receiver wall clock (mapped with the ping/pong offset) minus cap at presentDecodedSample

metrics.caveat: The default AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer path decodes inside the system layer and reports no decode time.
metrics.source: ReceiverVideoDecoder decode duration (experimental Metal path only)

metrics.caveat: Measures the AsyncStream command queue and MainActor scheduling only; the queue is unbounded by design and is not changed here.
metrics.source: ReceiverVideoPresenter: command yield until the MainActor pump processes it

metrics.caveat: Enqueued for presentation, not presented: the layer decides when a frame reaches the screen.
metrics.source: Successive AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer.enqueue calls in ReceiverVideoPresenter

metrics.caveat: Experimental Metal path only, which itself changes timing. Starts at encoder submission, not capture. Not capture-to-photon. Values outside -50 to 5000 ms are dropped, so p99 and max under-report a pathological latency.
metrics.source: Metal drawable presented handler (StreamReceiver.recordPresented) minus cap

metrics.caveat: Control-message round trip; it rides behind any queued video on the same connection. Both ends of the span are this device's wall clock (the ping time also feeds the clock offset), so a clock step during a round trip skews one sample; samples outside 0-2000 ms are dropped.
metrics.source: Receiver ping to sender pong on the control channel

metrics.caveat: One sample per restart (resync, reconnect). The arrival interval restarts its baseline at a restart, so this gap is not in it.
metrics.source: Last frame arrival before a presentation generation change to the first arrival after it (StreamDiagnosticsRecorder.noteGeneration)

metrics.caveat: Only while the Performance Lab fixture is on screen and only on the experimental Metal path, which itself changes timing. Measured at the decoded-frame handoff, not on glass.
metrics.source: PerformanceLabFrameIDProbe: successive decoded frames carrying a new Performance Lab fixture frame ID (ReceiverVideoPresenter.presentDecoded)

metrics.caveat: Display capture only (Mirror, Extend). The closest available proxy for source-unique frames: ScreenCaptureKit sends a complete frame when content changed.
metrics.source: SCK callback, status complete with pixels

metrics.caveat: The source did not change; not a drop.
metrics.source: SCK callback, status idle
SCK callback, status blank/suspended/started/stopped or no pixels

metrics.caveat: Admitted by the rate limiter; may still be dropped by backpressure.
metrics.source: FrameAdmission.offer returned send

metrics.caveat: Normal rate limiting at about 2x capture headroom: expected to be roughly as many as admitted frames while content moves.
metrics.source: FrameAdmission.offer returned hold

metrics.caveat: The encoder already had its in-flight limit of frames.
metrics.source: pending_encode backpressure (overlay enc↓)

metrics.caveat: The trailing-edge hold released the last change on screen.
metrics.source: retryHeldFrame offered a held frame again

metrics.caveat: The transport still had its limit of unsent video frames.
metrics.source: pending_sends backpressure (overlay net↓)
Encoder submission straight from a capture callback

metrics.caveat: A delayed but not duplicated frame.
metrics.source: Encoder submission of a held frame

metrics.caveat: Re-encodes the newest pixels after send backpressure cleared.
metrics.source: replayLastFrameAfterDrop
Watchdog keyframe replay on a static screen after reconnect

metrics.caveat: Uniqueness comes from the compose counters, not the PTS.
metrics.source: Encoder submission of a Window view composite

metrics.caveat: A pixel buffer captured once and submitted once. Display capture only.
metrics.source: Submission whose capture PTS differs from the previous submission's

metrics.caveat: Replays of pixels already encoded.
metrics.source: Submission repeating the previous submission's capture PTS
Submission without a capture PTS (Window view composite, replay before any capture)
VideoToolbox output callback with noErr
Submit or output callback failure

metrics.caveat: Encoded but intentionally never sent.
metrics.source: Encoded output from a retired session or generation

metrics.caveat: Video payload only; framing, TLS, QUIC/TCP and IP overhead are not counted.
metrics.source: Annex B payload size of each encoded frame
Encoded frames that are sync samples
Video send completion without error
Video send completion with an error

metrics.caveat: App payload, not bytes billed by a network: encryption, transport and tunnel overhead are not included.
metrics.source: Framed video bytes whose send completed
WindowWorkspaceEngine composites delivered

metrics.caveat: Duplicates by design (heal a lost frame).
metrics.source: Composites made by the ~1 s static resend, not by a change

metrics.caveat: Sampled about every 2 s.
metrics.source: Route class changed between samples
Capture or presentation generation changed; interval baselines restart

metrics.caveat: Counts extractions, not frames. Never per frame; the Colour metadata group reports what they found.
metrics.source: A colour metadata extraction (pixel buffer attachments, format description extensions, SPS VUI), taken once per stream generation or format change
Complete video frames at presentDecodedSample

metrics.caveat: Video payload only.
metrics.source: Sample buffer size of each arrived frame

metrics.caveat: Enqueued for presentation, never confirmed on glass.
metrics.source: AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer.enqueue or Metal handoff
Presenter generation check discarded a frame

metrics.caveat: Experimental Metal path only. The only presentation this app can observe.
metrics.source: Metal drawable presented handler
Display layer failed and was flushed

metrics.caveat: Experimental Metal path only; only while the lab fixture is visible.
metrics.source: Decoded frames whose Performance Lab frame-ID strip was read

metrics.caveat: Source-unique fixture frames that reached the decoded-frame handoff.
metrics.source: Read frame IDs that differ from the previous read ID

metrics.caveat: The same source frame handed over again (replay, static resend or re-encode).
metrics.source: Read frame IDs equal to the previous read ID

metrics.caveat: A lower bound on fixture frames drawn on the Mac that never reached this point (an unread frame may have carried a missing ID). Rate limiting at a lower target FPS skips frames by design. Counted only while the reader follows a strip.
metrics.source: IDs provably missing between two successive read IDs: the ID difference minus one, minus the frames that arrived in between but could not be read

metrics.caveat: Blended, partially updated or heavily compressed frames; also the fixture leaving the screen.
metrics.source: Decoded frames where a located strip failed its guard or checksum

metrics.caveat: Not counted as skipped: the reader re-baselines when it finds the strip again.
metrics.source: Decoded frames the reader did not read while it searched for a lost strip again (it probes one frame in 30)

metrics.caveat: Fixture restarted; counting starts again from the new ID.
metrics.source: Read ID went backwards or jumped by more than half the counter range
Frames in flight in the encoder, sampled at each submission
Video frames awaiting send completion, sampled at each send

metrics.caveat: Counts only commands yielded while diagnostics were on.
metrics.source: ReceiverVideoPresenter commands yielded but not yet processed, sampled at each yield
Panes on the canvas at each composite
Floating panes on the canvas at each composite
Panes drawn dimmed (offscreen, closed, paused) at each composite
Panes that had a captured frame at each composite

metrics.caveat: Control-channel jitter, not video arrival jitter. A session value, not a window value; reported only after 8 RTT samples (one per receiver ping, about every 2 s).
metrics.source: Smoothed absolute difference of successive RTT samples (RFC 3550: starts at 0, gain 1/16), over the session

metrics.caveat: Whole process, sampled once per window (5 s). Not GPU, encoder or decoder hardware load.
metrics.source: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) user+system time delta over wall time between samples

metrics.caveat: Whole process.
metrics.source: task_info TASK_VM_INFO phys_footprint

metrics.caveat: Coarse four-level system state.
metrics.source: ProcessInfo.thermalState
ProcessInfo.isLowPowerModeEnabled

metrics.caveat: Unknown elsewhere.
metrics.source: UIDevice.batteryState (iOS, only while the diagnostics page is open)
